modern: A man has seldom been seen to be unhappy through not observing what is in another’s mind; but those who do not observe the movements of their own minds must necessarily be unhappy.
original: Through not observing what is in the mind of another a man has seldom been seen to be unhappy; but those who do not observe the movements of their own minds must of necessity be unhappy.
